title: Parameter and result types
hints: Every Go function lists its parameter types, and its result type after the parentheses. A function that returns a value must say what type it returns.
Consecutive parameters of the same type can share it: func Add(a, b int). A function that declares a result must end every path with a return statement.
func Add(a, b int) int { return a + b } and, in Greeting, return "Hello, " + name + "!"
